title: Application MailRelay Entity
description: Common properties shared by all mail relay applications (Postfix, msmtp, etc.).

relay_host.description: Upstream SMTP server to relay mail through.

relay_port.description: Port of the upstream SMTP server.

from_address.description: Default sender address for system mail.

tls.description: Whether to use TLS for the relay connection.

auth.description: Authentication credentials for the relay server.

password_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for the SMTP password.
